g.text: /help for help, /status for your current setup
ry "fix the failing test" — / for commands, @ for files, ! for bash, ? for shortcuts
! for bash mode double tap esc to clear input ctrl + c twice to exit
/ for commands shift + tab to cycle modes ctrl + v to paste images
@ for file paths ctrl + o for verbose output ctrl + b for subtasks
ctrl + r for history ctrl + t to toggle tasks \⏎ or ctrl + j for newline
↑ ↓ for earlier prompts esc to interrupt
